head_commit.message:
codex-rs: normalize images for Responses strict mode

Gate Responses Codex strict mode behind the feature flag, normalize local and tool-output images before history/request construction, and reject unsupported remote image URLs when strict mode is enabled.

Add coverage for app-server turn start, code mode image outputs, and request fallback behavior.
